    {"name": "instruction_delivery_quality", "analytical_usefulness": 0.9, "source_groundedness": 0.88, "rationale": "A meaningful axis for grouping satisfaction by teaching quality; directly actionable for educators. Values track source well (ED-0001 frozen/lagging=minimal_passive, ED-0004 engaging clips=responsive_personalized).", "hallucination_observed": false},
    {"name": "subject_format_fit", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "rationale": "Useful for identifying which subjects suit remote format, informing improvements. Readings are warranted (algebra whiteboard issues=constrained; recorded history lectures=well_suited).", "hallucination_observed": false},
    {"name": "hands_on_criticality", "analytical_usefulness": 0.82, "source_groundedness": 0.82, "rationale": "Gives leverage on whether missing hands-on components drive dissatisfaction. ED-0002 kitchen-chemistry=workable_with_substitutes is sound; ED-0001 algebra=essential_missing is a slightly loose inference but defensible.", "hallucination_observed": false},
    {"name": "peer_community_presence", "analytical_usefulness": 0.88, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "Strong actionable axis; peer interaction is repeatedly mentioned. ED-0003 zero peer interaction and ED-0005 silent chat map correctly.", "hallucination_observed": false},
    {"name": "learner_control_over_pace", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "rationale": "Self-paced vs synchronous is a clear improvement lever. ED-0004 pause/own-pace=self_paced_flexible and synchronous whiteboard cases=rigidly_synchronous are well grounded.", "hallucination_observed": false},
    {"name": "pedagogical_innovation_level", "analytical_usefulness": 0.83, "source_groundedness": 0.78, "rationale": "Relevant for surfacing effective practices. Mostly grounded, but ED-0001/ED-0005 assigning 'minimal_adjustment' is inferential where the text is largely silent on the teacher's innovation, a mild over-read.", "hallucination_observed": false},
    {"name": "resource_equity_gap", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.68, "rationale": "Equity is a valid lever, but values are weakly supported: individual tech glitches (frozen camera, logouts) are labeled 'high_disparity' when the text describes personal connectivity issues, not evidenced cross-learner disparity. Some inference stretches beyond source.", "hallucination_observed": true}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.85,
  "source_groundedness": 0.82,
  "rationale": "The added columns provide multiple distinct, non-redundant axes (delivery quality, format fit, peer presence, pace control, innovation, equity) that each give real analytical leverage for improving learning satisfaction and can be cross-tabulated against satisfaction_1to5 and role. Most values are sound readings of the open responses, with appropriate 'not_present' for silent rows. The main weakness is resource_equity_gap, which sometimes infers systemic disparity from individual technical glitches, and pedagogical_innovation_level occasionally over-reads teacher innovation from thin text. Overall the set is useful and largely grounded."
}
